preconditions.description: The dimensions n (rows) and m (columns) are within the specified bounds.
The starting coordinates (r, c) are within the grid boundaries.
The maximum allowed left (x) and right (y) moves are non-negative integers.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid consists of exactly n rows, each with exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in '.*' for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either a free cell '.' or an obstacle '*'.
The starting cell is guaranteed to be free of obstacles.

postconditions.expression: output_int == sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if is_reachable(i, j, n, m, r, c, x, y, grid))
postconditions.description: The output integer equals the count of all cells (i, j) in the grid that are reachable from the starting cell (r, c) under the movement constraints.

postconditions.expression: is_reachable(r-1, c-1, n, m, r, c, x, y, grid)
postconditions.description: The starting cell itself is always considered reachable.
